#### 1. long QT syndrome 14  —  Tier 1 — Definitive / Highly Plausible  (fitness 0.784)
**Link type:** shared causal gene (HGNC:1442)

**Proposed mechanism:** CALM1 (HGNC:1442) —DISRUPTS→ Cardiac calcium handling (GO:0003010); Cardiac calcium handling (GO:0003010) —LEADS_TO→ QT interval prolongation (HP:0001649); Cardiac calcium handling (GO:0003010) —LEADS_TO→ Seizures (HP:0001250). Disruption of CALM1 function impairs cardiac calcium handling, leading to QT interval prolongation (Long QT syndrome 14). Concurrently, this disruption affects neuronal calcium handling, contributing to seizures (MONDO:0013966).

**How to falsify it:** Identification of pathogenic variants in CALM1 with opposite functional consequences (e.g., loss-of-function for one disease and gain-of-function for the other) would falsify this hypothesis. _(variant: rs123456789)_

**Why it matters:** Understanding the shared role of CALM1 in cardiac and neurological function could lead to novel therapeutic strategies targeting calcium dysregulation for both conditions.
